title: Rudrashtakam
intro: Rudrashtakam is a powerful hymn dedicated to Lord Shiva. Read the lyrics, meaning, and spiritual benefits of Rudrashtakam.
description:
namamishishaana nirvaanarupam
vibhum vyapakam brahmavedasvarupam
nizam nirgunam nirvikalpam nireeham
chidaakashamakashavasam bhajeham

niraakaaramonkaramulam turiyam
gira-jnan-gotitamisham girisham |
karalam mahakalakalam kripalam
gunaagarasamsaraparam natoham

tusharadrisankashagauram gabhiram
manobhutakotiprabhashri shariram |
sphuranmaulikallolini charuganga
lasad-bhalabalendu kanthe bhujanga

chalatkundalam bhrusunetram vishalam
prasannananam neelakantham dayalam |
mrigadhishacharmambaram mundamalam
priyam shankaram sarvanatham bhajami

prachandam prakrishtam pragalbham paresham
akhandam ajam bhanukotiprakasham |
tryah-shula-nirmulanam shulapanim
bhajeham bhavanipatim bhavagamyam

kalateetakalyana kalpantakari
sada sajjananandadata purari |
chidanandasandoha mohapahari
prasida prasida prabho manmathari

na yavad umanathapadaravindam
bhajantiha loke pare va naranam |
na tavatsukham shanti santapanasham
prasida prabho sarvabhutadhivasam

na janami yogam japam naiva pujan
natoham sada sarvada shambhutubhyam |
jarajanmaduhkhaugha tatapyamanam
prabho pahi apannamamish shambho

faq.a1: Rudrashtakam was composed by the great saint and poet Goswami Tulsidas. It is a very popular and sacred stotra from the Uttarakanda of his famous epic 'Ramcharitmanas'.
faq.q2: What is the main purpose and significance of Rudrashtakam?
faq.a2: Rudrashtakam is a powerful stotra praising Lord Shiva and describing His formless, all-pervading, and supreme benevolent nature. Its purpose is to awaken complete devotion towards Lord Shiva and seek His refuge.
faq.q3: How many verses are there in Rudrashtakam?
faq.a3: As the name suggests, Rudrashtakam contains a total of 8 verses, beautifully describing the divine form, adornment, and glory of Lord Shiva.
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Rudrashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular recitation brings mental peace, removes all types of physical and mental sufferings, diseases, fears, and the fear of untimely death, and grants liberation through the grace of Lord Shiva.
faq.q5: When and how should Rudrashtakam be recited?
faq.a5: Rudrashtakam should be recited daily in the morning or evening after bathing, by lighting a lamp before Lord Shiva. Reciting it during Mahashivratri, Pradosh Vrat, and the holy month of Shravan is considered especially auspicious.
